title: Recipe box

spec.summary: Each signed-in user keeps a private list of recipes with a name and a cooking time in minutes.
outputs: 201 on create, 204 on delete, 400 on bad input

acceptance_checks.description: Recipes are scoped to the logged-in user.

acceptance_checks.how_to_verify: No query is built with string templates.

acceptance_checks.description: POST rejects a missing name or a non-positive minutes value with 400.

hints: Look at how server/routes/todos.js filters by user.
Validation goes before the INSERT: check typeof name and Number.isInteger(minutes).
Use db.prepare("INSERT INTO recipes (user_id, name, minutes) VALUES (?, ?, ?)").
